verdict.rationale: Abacum's security page says it keeps a detailed history giving full visibility into every edit event on data models, spaces and dimension mappings. That covers the change-logging half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows edits can be rolled back, and the docs never explicitly say each event records who made the change and when. Missing for 10: documented rollback/restore of prior model states, explicit who/what/when fields in the edit history, independent or hands-on corroboration.
